hybrid_projection_probe.method: Real GGUF rows, concurrent separate Vulkan and XDNA backend calls, eight repetitions, Dibs CLEAN before and after; NRMSE versus full GPU below 0.014
hybrid_projection_probe.profile: Warm NPU partial calls: roughly 5-6 ms in host passes and 1.3-1.5 ms in NPU submissions and waits
hybrid_projection_probe.conclusion: A simple output-column split through the existing host-staged backends loses to GPU alone

iq3s_npu_decoder_prototype.scope: One AIE2P core decodes 64 rows x one 256-value IQ3_S GGUF superblock into 18,432 BFP16 bytes; standalone kernel, not connected to inference
iq3s_npu_decoder_prototype.reference: blk.2.ffn_down.weight; all 18,432 bytes matched an independent GGUF/BFP oracle
iq3s_npu_decoder_prototype.method: 1,000 kernel submissions and waits, Dibs CLEAN before and after each run
iq3s_npu_decoder_prototype.conclusion: Correct, but too slow for execution-time dequantization across the model; requires vectorized decoding and integration with GEMM
